$comment: Maps the folders in this repo to the VS Code user profiles they were exported from (see %APPDATA%/Code/User/globalStorage/storage.json -> userDataProfiles). The 'location' hash is machine specific and changes when a profile is recreated.

profiles.description: Current default profile. Personal styling + keybindings, to be turned into its own profile.
Minimalistic profile: no tabs, hidden activity bar/status bar, no line numbers, flat theme.
Profile used for LaTeX documents and Jupyter notebooks.
Angular and Python development with Angular Language Service, Pylance, Ruff and Prettier. Local database connections omitted.
